lemmas.name: pow4_iff
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Nat), (∃ m : Nat, n = 4 ^ m) ↔ (List.range (n + 1)).any (fun m => decide (n = 4 ^ m)) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro n
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    have hlt : m < 4 ^ m := Nat.lt_pow_self (by omega)
    refine ⟨m, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by simpa using hm⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨m, _, hm⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h
    exact ⟨m, by simpa using hm⟩

lemmas.name: pow4_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (h : ifPowerOfFour_precond n), ifPowerOfFour_postcond n ((List.range (n + 1)).any (fun m => decide (n = 4 ^ m))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro n h
  unfold ifPowerOfFour_postcond
  exact (pow4_iff n).symm
